timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after the first Campaign277 cross-stage regression command; not a market-data or host-wall-clock measurement.
failure_reason: The command used tests/data_collector_tests node prefixes while the configured pytest collection root emitted data_collector_tests node IDs. Four historical lifecycle nodes therefore ran and failed only because append-only unified reports have newer bytes.
recovery: Rerun the identical file scope with the four exact collected data_collector_tests node IDs deselected. Preserve all historical tests and artifacts unchanged.
